_comment: Skies shipped inside the mod jar. Empty by default so the jar stays small and the
users own packs in .minecraft/skyloom/skies are the content.
To ship one: drop the sheet into assets/skyloom/textures/sky and add an entry below.
Sheets use the OptiFine layout, three columns by two rows,
top row bottom/top/east, bottom row south/west/north.
Per layer keys: texture, blend, rotate, speed, axis,
"description": "Shown as the subtitle while hovering the card.",
